newsitem.title: THAILAND: More Thai sugar mills close as crushing slows.
newsitem.headline: More Thai sugar mills close as crushing slows.

text.p: More Thai sugar mills closed for the 1996/97 crushing season as cane supplies depleted and sugar production slowed down, industry sources said on Thursday.
The crushing season starts in November and lasts until May or June.
As of April 10, a total of 12 out of 46 mills had stopped operations for the season, but the sources told Reuters more mills might have closed during the Songkran holiday which ended on Tuesday.
Sugar output as of that date reached 5.71 million tonnes, compared with 5.75 in the same period last year.

The sources said that the yield this year would not match that of last season's as the latest data showed the yield was only 102.90 kg of sugar per tonne of sugar cane, below 105.46 kg in the same period last year.
